newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore says modern telecoms key to its future.
newsitem.headline: Singapore says modern telecoms key to its future.

text.p: A modern telecommunications network is a key to Singapore's future economic competitiveness, Communications Minister Mah Bow Tan said on Friday.
"A key factor that has enabled Singapore to stay competitive economically is our modern and efficient telecommunications network," Mah said.
To be competitive it was "imperative that we continue to expand and upgrade our telecommunications facilities", he said.
The minister was speaking at the official opening of Singapore Telecommunications Ltd's Singapore $150 million Telepark centre.
Telepark is an out-sourcing centre for computer data and telecommunications operations and maintenance.
Mah said Telepark would help establish Singapore as a world class centre for telecommunications and would enhance Singapore's position as an international business hub.
